output.title: Ingress pathType change: can't tell which Ingresses are affected or used
output.content: The release note (ev-4faa7ca81b54) says the Kubernetes Ingress `pathType` changes from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact` in v1.18.0. It doesn't say which Ingress objects cert-manager creates with this setting or when it creates them. The environment summary shows no networking Ingress apiVersion and no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests, and the CRDs dimension is absent, so we can't confirm whether this cluster relies on cert-manager-created Ingresses. The only related signal is the values key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`, which is set but its value isn't shown; to decide, check which issuers and solvers you use, whether they create Ingresses, and whether your ingress controller handles `Exact` paths the way it handles `ImplementationSpecific`.
